name: 48. Integration-Axis Criss-Cross (umbrella drop-ins x dialect x provider x feature)
description:
Folder 47 crossed endpoint shape x provider x feature under the bare prefixes (/v1, /openai, /anthropic, /genai, /bedrock). This folder adds the INTEGRATION axis.

The umbrella integrations re-mount every shape family under their own prefix - langchain.go:22-37 is CreateOpenAIRouteConfigs('/langchain') + CreateAnthropicRouteConfigs + CreateGenAIRouteConfigs + CreateBedrockRouteConfigs + CreateCohereRouteConfigs, and /litellm, /pydanticai and /cursor do the same. So /langchain/v2/chat pointed at anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 is Cohere's dialect on LangChain's prefix against Anthropic's backend: three vendors in one request.

Rounds 18-22 and 27 already exercise these prefixes, but they send bare models (gpt-4o-mini, claude-haiku-4-5, command-a-03-2025) with no provider prefix, so every row is native-shape - the same gap Rounds 23-26 had one level down. Every row here carries an explicit provider/model prefix.

Assertions are folder 47's, keyed by endpoint dialect. Cohere v2 chat routes return the provider's raw Cohere body for native Cohere calls and convert foreign-provider responses into Cohere v2 shape with top-level message, finish_reason, and usage fields. The Cohere-family rows assert that public API shape.

Native-dialect cells (/langchain/v1/messages -> anthropic, etc.) are omitted: they are not criss-cross and belong to Rounds 18-22. [SKIP] tags cite in-repo evidence - rerank is a real implementation in only bedrock/cohere/vertex/vllm, every other provider returns NewUnsupportedOperationError.
